description: Prints ostack's shipped model defaults (hooks/ostack-defaults.md) when a session starts, resumes, clears, or compacts, or on its first prompt if no session start printed them. Turns onyo-mode on for every prompt, and adds the onyo-projects rules in a Claude Projects session. In Projects it also prints the onyo-projects sections for the session's role when a session starts, resumes, clears, or compacts. A line saying `onyo-mode off` in CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, or the project instructions turns it off for the project, and one in a message turns it off for the session. In a Projects coordinator it also refuses a start_thread_session call whose brief does not open with the `onyo-projects: planning thread` or `onyo-projects: unit thread` line, and a unit thread start whose brief is not word for word in a planning thread's report or that has no project_post_id. In a Projects coordinator it also blocks the end of a turn once when the turn received a thread's report and no post in the project chat links that thread, and after a start_thread_session with a project_ack it reminds the coordinator that the project_ack already posted.
